projects.name: Cold Email Generator
projects.description: A tool that automates cold email generation for service companies. It extracts job listings from a company's careers page and writes personalized outreach offering tailored engineering services.
highlights: Extracts job listings from a company's careers page
Generates personalized outreach emails for business development teams

projects.name: GDP Dashboard
projects.description: A simple Streamlit app showing the GDP of different countries in the world.
highlights: Runs locally with pip install and a single streamlit run command

projects.name: metricdiff
projects.description: Diffs two snapshots of your metrics and fails the build when something moves too much. It flags added, removed and breaching metrics against percent and absolute thresholds, from CSV or JSON input.
highlights: Exits non-zero on any material change, so it drops into CI or a cron job
Covers percent and absolute thresholds, dimensions and zero baselines
Backed by 33 tests

projects.name: quarry
projects.description: A vectorized SQL query engine over Apache Arrow, written from scratch in Rust. It includes a parser, binder, rule-based optimizer with join reordering, and hash join and aggregate operators, checked against SQLite.
highlights: All 22 TPC-H-like benchmark queries and 93 feature queries return the same rows as SQLite
Join reordering by estimated cardinality, with scans over memory, CSV and Parquet

projects.name: axebudget
projects.description: An accessibility regression gate that freezes existing WCAG violations into an expiring debt ledger. CI fails only on new violations, over-budget components or debt past its deadline.
highlights: Per-component budgets and severity-weighted expiry on owned, dated debt
Burndown reporting and a CI report naming each new or expired violation
Covered by 15 tests against 12 seeded violations

projects.name: adrlint
projects.description: A decision-record linter that builds a graph of architecture decisions. It flags unresolved contradictions, expired reviews and orphaned supersedes chains while staying quiet about pairs already resolved.
highlights: Detects two live decisions that contradict each other, with scope hierarchy awareness
Reports overdue reviews and ownerless accepted decisions
Covered by 21 tests

projects.name: stridediff
projects.description: Architecture-as-code tool that computes a STRIDE threat delta for every change. It fails CI when a new trust-boundary crossing has no recorded mitigation.
highlights: Reports added, removed and escalated threats between two model versions
Pull-request comment with the verdict and an embedded Mermaid data-flow diagram
Covered by 24 tests

projects.name: dmarcwatch
projects.description: Email deliverability monitoring from DMARC aggregate reports. It separates mail that never arrived from mail that arrived and was ignored, and flags unauthorised senders.
highlights: Splits an open-rate drop into deliverability and engagement components that sum to the observed change
Demo corpus of 145 report documents from 5 providers
Includes a browser version of the analysis
